column1: # Sign-by-sign check of Brice Dudout's reading (Oct 2026) against the key on BnF fr. 3462, Gallica btv1b9058227h view 112.
# Checked 20 Oct 2026 from the image copy in his dossier repository (key-112.webp, 1800 x 1580 px) and from the letter
# crops (f17-l1..l3, f19-l1..l2); Gallica's IIIF answered 403 (Cloudflare) on that day.
# Cells: plaintext letter + row (A1 = column A, first homophone from the top), as on view 112. "nom." = nomenclator entry.
# status: key = the sign is in that cell on view 112 and the cell gives Brice's value;
#         tomokiyo = barred number not on view 112 (its page, the N-Z continuation, is not in hand); value as corroborated by Tomokiyo, 17 Oct 2026;
#         conflict = the closest cell on view 112 gives another value than the reading;
#         probable = the cell fits but the entry or the shape is not certain.
# old = our 21 Sept transcription token(s) (ct_sept.txt / ct_nov.txt); 98 glyphs in all (59 + 39).
